desc: When it comes to getting enough fiber in your diet, skip the powders and start enjoying high fiber. Each serving of Fiber One Original Cereal delivers 65% daily value of fiber and 0g added sugar (not a low calorie food, see nutrition information for calorie content). Beyond an excellent source of fiber, this cereal is a good source of calcium with 18g whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily). Serve some as part of a quick and easy breakfast that helps you meet your daily fiber needs. Sprinkle some in yogurt or smoothies as a crunchy anytime snack. Toss some in trail mix recipes for high fiber snacks that help you shine from the inside out. Whether you reach for Fiber One Cereal to support your digestive health, as a breakfast food with whole grain, or as an ingredient in healthy snacks recipes, General Mills breakfast cereals spread goodness from tots to grown-ups. Contains one cardboard box of crunchy Fiber One Breakfast Cereal, Original Bran, 19.6 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals.
features:
• HIGH FIBER CEREAL: Delivers 65% daily value of fiber per serving - Diets high in fiber can help keep your digestive system on track; An ideal ready to eat pantry staple that the whole family can enjoy
  • TASTY BREAKFAST ADDITION: A delicious cereal containing whole grains and 90 calories per serving to help get your morning started; Serve a bowl of cereal with milk or add some to cereal bars recipes for snacks on the go
  • MADE WITH WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving of this breakfast cereal provides 18g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) and is a good source of calcium
  • FIBER SNACKS: Enjoy as a tasty cold cereal, or add the great taste to recipes for bran muffins or high fiber cookies
  • CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Fiber One Breakfast Cereal, Original Bran, 19.6 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Corn Bran, Modified Wheat Starch, Color Added, Guar Gum, Cellulose Gum, Salt, Baking Soda, Sucralose. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12.
